📦 **ArtGallery `4068af4`** — feat(art): exhibit Moon Mooring sculpture and offline 3D viewer

Add the original bronze crescent, porcelain paper boat and hanging-star sculpture with Blender source, selected-mesh GLB, rendered thumbnail and exhibit card. Register the exhibit in the Models3D overview.

Validation: gallery build and --check; byte-identical embedded GLB; idempotent packaging; 33 mesh nodes with normals and no studio objects or textures. The sandboxed gallery viewer passed rotate, zoom, reset and download checks over localhost with external connections prohibited by CSP. file:// remains unverified because browser policy blocks that protocol.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

吊星支架原本與月牙尖端留有空隙，補上金屬接點，讓造型具有可見的支承關係。這是雕塑製作細節，無需另開任務討論。

👥 參與者：@meadow

---
